name: PCAPdroid
description_en: No-root network monitor, firewall and PCAP dumper for Android
readme_excerpt: PCAPdroid PCAPdroid is a privacy-friendly open source app which can track, analyze and block the connections made by the other apps on the device. It can also export a PCAP dump of the traffic, inspect HTTP requests, decrypt TLS traffic and much more. PCAPdroid simulates a VPN in order to capture the network traffic without root.
